name: Acoustic Spaces v2
summary: The 3D + LTX template, version two: five World Builder rooms rendered by LTX-2.5 Layout-to-Render (open weights) on the owner's track, each room's own CPU room sound under it, cut on the phrases on a double-time grid, with every room, the track and every overlay a swappable layer. Nothing is generated.

versions.title: Five rooms, every layer its own
versions.summary: The fifth mix template: five room files, one shot each at sourceSeconds 0 on the phrases, the re-measured room-sound track, a REC HUD per room, a wireframe sweep and slice glitch into every room, the cathedral room scan, the dancer box with its baked heatmap, the pyramid reveal, the studio readout and the end card.
changes: Five room files cut from the assembled picture at each room's own first frame, 1920 x 1080, CRF 18, no sound
Plain pyramid files listed so the hologram is a swap
No new recipe: screen-open, crt, hud, wire-scan, slice-glitch, gen-title, scan, ui-focus, gen-status, build-panel and end-card-still
Gallery: Acoustic Spaces v2 (3D · LTX template) after Adaptive reverb

versions.title: The singer's ending, the credit as a layer
versions.summary: The owner's approved cut made the template: the studio shot is the original Adaptive reverb take's singer turning to the camera and smiling, the end-card still is replaced by a REACTIVE SPACES credit traced in beside her with gen-title, and the studio readout runs four track beats. Every other room, the track and every other overlay are unchanged; the booth render stays listed as a swap.
changes: Studio picture: the last 97 frames (26.417 to 30.458 s) of the original Adaptive reverb take, upscaled once from 1280 x 720 to 1920 x 1080, lanczos, CRF 18, no sound
The booth render kept as drop-studio-booth.mp4, unused by the cut, so the studio swaps back
End card still removed; end-title (gen-title, trace-texts) on lane cards for the last 5.2 track beats, x 0.31 (the text centre), y 0.3, size 46, plate 0.3
Studio readout (build-panel, ROOM · STUDIO) 4 track beats instead of 6
The track and its room sound unchanged: the studio's decay is still the booth capture's (RT60 0.20 to 0.34 s)

events.reason: Owner, 3 Nov 2026: "a proper director template with all the layers included. They should be visible as layers, swappable. Every detail should be there to swap. Basically, whatever it was used." Interpreted as: each room its own video asset and shot, the track an audio asset, the end card a still, every overlay its own layer.

guidance.value: Five room files, one per shot at sourceSeconds 0; the track one file; every overlay its own layer; the hologram swappable through plain pyramid files.

events.reason: Coordinator, 3 Nov 2026: do not move the picture cuts off the phrases; cut on a double-time grid, 273.6 BPM at 24 fps, shots at beats 0 / 33 / 65 / 97 / 129 (frames 0 / 174 / 342 / 511 / 679), 776 frames; layers doubled from the interface cut, their bpm parameter kept at 136.8.

guidance.value: Double-time grid so the picture cuts on the phrases while the overlays snap.

events.reason: Owner, 3 Nov 2026, on the opening: it "almost looks like a title drop, maybe it could be longer". The DROP gen-title starts at track beat 2.5 and lasts 14 track beats, its build 4 s.

guidance.value: The DROP title runs 4 s over 14 track beats.

events.reason: Owner notes, 3 Nov 2026 (interface variant b): visor distortion gentle, no effect repeated room after room, UI on different sides, Transitions.dev reveals (gen-title, gen-status) instead of a readout everywhere, the dancer box kept with its depth heatmap baked in, the exterior pyramid revealed by a wireframe sweep with no readout.

guidance.value: Variant b of the interface pass, layer for layer.

events.reason: The room sound is the browser shoebox engine per capture (docs/world-builder-dynamic-sound.md); the towers' street and the cathedral's nave proxies were re-captured so their acoustic width follows the measured gap of their side rows (street 22.8 to 5.7 m, nave 28 to 7 m). The re-captures reproduced their rendered guides byte for byte. The track mixes each room's dynamic room sound at wet 0.45 under the dry track.

Owner, 3 Nov 2026 about 20:45, on the cut ending on the singer: "great, use it as official template with all the layers". Interpreted as: that cut (spaces-v2f-interface-b) becomes the template, with every overlay still its own visible, swappable layer and nothing merged.

guidance.value: Match the approved v2f render layer for layer; keep every layer separate.

events.reason: Owner's corrections in this round, as the run log records them in its own words (not verbatim): the previous interface version was good and stays; use the measured room-sound audio; end on the singer who turns and smiles, from the original Adaptive reverb take, rather than a booth render, with the credit traced in beside her instead of an end-card still.

guidance.value: The studio shot is the original take's last 97 frames; the credit is a gen-title layer over it.

events.reason: Found on the first v2f render: gen-title's x is the text's centre, so the credit at x 0.2 clipped at the left edge; it sits at x 0.31, size 46.
